exp.desc:
- À la carte service for 60 covers
- Wine pairing and decanting
- Groups and cash-up

cl.p1: When a guest orders the same wine twice without looking at the list, I take it as a compliment – and it happens often in my current restaurant because I remember what regulars like.
cl.p2: I have worked front of house for seven years, the last four in a 60-cover restaurant with around 200 wines. I recommend pairings, decant, look after groups and cash up at night. Last year I completed a wine course so I could explain pairings better.
cl.p3: Your focus on small producers matches what I enjoy most. I can start in March.

cl.p1: I am a student in Bath and looking for weekend work this season. Your beer garden is my favourite place in summer, and I have seen how busy it gets.
cl.p2: I have two summers of waiting experience at village festivals. I can carry three plates, remember orders for a table of twelve and stay friendly when it is packed. I pick up till systems quickly.
cl.p3: I can work Friday evenings and all day on weekends.
